name: libcxxabi

patches.reason: This project's own crt1.o never defines __dso_handle (Bionic's real crtbegin/crtend split is not imported), and libc++abi's static-init-guard code needs a real symbol of that exact name to reference. A tiny CRT-owned shim source, wired into libcxxabi's own build via this one-line CMakeLists.txt insertion rather than patched into the freestanding CRT startup objects themselves.

notes: Deliberately no LIBCXXABI_USE_LLVM_UNWINDER/LIBCXXABI_LIBUNWIND_INCLUDES/dependency on ../libunwind here, on any host: that CMake option only changes libcxxabi's own compile-time #ifdef selection (real libunwind.h API vs. the generic, portable Itanium _Unwind_* ABI surface) -- it does not, by itself, make the CMake-standalone-build cxxabi_shared/cxxabi_static targets actually link against a real libunwind (that automatic wiring only fires inside a combined, single-configure LLVM "runtimes" build where libunwind was add_subdirectory()'d into the *same* CMake project graph, which AOSP's split-repo layout -- libcxx/libcxxabi/libunwind are three separate git repos -- makes impractical here anyway; confirmed by reading libcxxabi's own src/CMakeLists.txt, which checks `TARGET unwind_shared`/`HAVE_LIBUNWIND`, neither ever satisfiable from a separate `cmake -S -B` invocation). The plain default (this option OFF) Itanium ABI surface libcxxabi already compiles against is exactly what a real libunwind exports too, so the only real cross-reference this needs is a link-time one -- see tools/crt-c++'s own per-OS cxx_runtime_libs, and ../libunwind/recipe.json's own notes for where each host's libunwind actually comes from (built here on Windows only; a host package on Linux; not needed at all on macOS).
macos needs nothing special here either: LIBCXXABI_USE_LLVM_UNWINDER simply stays at its upstream default (OFF), matching Darwin's own already-verified-working libSystem unwinder.
